title: Biscay/Atlantic low, Storm Babet period
notes: 19 Oct 2023 sits inside the Storm Babet spell (18-21 Oct): a slow-moving low that approached unusually from the south/southwest, driving prolonged easterly gales and record rain over Scotland. Centre position on the 19th uncertain in my recollection (west/northwest of Ireland to north of Scotland), so only a conservative 985 hPa depth expectation is scored. Confidence: high on the spell, low on instantaneous position (omitted).
